definition: The complete list of the values of a random variable with their probabilities (or a density).
To forget a variable, add over all its values. The result is a marginal, like p(rain).
The probability of y when we already know x: p(y | x) = p(x, y) / p(x).
Joint = conditional × marginal: p(x, y) = p(y | x) p(x).
Knowing one variable tells nothing about the other: p(x, y) = p(x) p(y).
